"""CPU-only owner/protocol fixture, never an admitted real engine."""
import sys

print('INFO context=262144 kv=int8 kv_resident=32768 expert_slots=144 spec=8 lookup=0 '
      'pool_workers=5 pcie_frac=0.00 conversation_cache_mib=0 vram_free_mib=1024', flush=True)
print('READY 262144 stop', flush=True)
for command in sys.stdin:
    if command == 'QUIT\n':
        raise SystemExit(0)
    if not command.startswith('GEN 16 ckpt=0 logprobs=5 '):
        print('ERR fixture command', flush=True)
        continue
    ids = command.split(' ', 4)[4].strip().split(',')
    if len(ids) != 32768:
        print('ERR fixture input count', flush=True)
        continue
    if '--stop-mode' in sys.argv:
        if sys.stdin.readline() != 'STOP\n':
            raise SystemExit(2)
        print('DONE 0 32768 100 0 stop 0 0 0 2 3 4 0 0.0 32768 0', flush=True)
        continue
    print('RESUME 0')
    print('PP 32767 32768 100 327670')
    print('REUSED 0')
    for _ in range(16):
        print('T 123')
        print('LP -0.1 123:-0.1 124:-1 125:-2 126:-3 127:-4')
    print('DONE 16 32768 100 200 length 0 0 0 2 3 4 0 0.0 32768 0', flush=True)
